**An asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic hypergeometric series**

*Takeshi MORITA∗*

12 pp, 7 sections.

**Abstract.** We show an asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic hypergeometric series 1ψ0(a; −; q, ·) with using the q-Borel-Laplace method. We also give the limit q →1 −0 of our asymptotic formula.

**Outline.** Front matter; 1 Introduction; 2 Basic notations; 3 An asymptotic formula of the divergent serie; 3.1 Local solutions of the degenerated equatio; 3.2 An asymptotic formula; 4 The limit q1-0 of the asymptotic formula
